components.name: success_bonus
components.description: Awarded when both legs contact ground, lander is near pad (distance < 0.1), vertical speed low (<0.5), horizontal speed low (<0.5), and angle small (<0.1 rad).
components.condition: state[6]==1 and state[7]==1 and distance_to_pad < 0.1 and abs(state[3]) < 0.5 and abs(state[2]) < 0.5 and abs(state[4]) < 0.1

components.name: distance_shaping
components.description: Reward for reducing distance to pad. Computed as -distance_to_pad * 2.0, so moving closer increases reward.

components.name: vertical_speed_shaping
components.description: Reward for low vertical speed (negative means descending). Encourages controlled descent. Computed as -abs(state[3]) * 1.0.

components.name: angle_shaping
components.description: Reward for upright orientation. Computed as -abs(state[4]) * 2.0.

components.name: fuel_penalty
components.description: Mild penalty for using main engine (m_power) and side engines (s_power).

components.name: time_penalty
components.description: Small per-step penalty to encourage fast landing.

components.name: horizontal_velocity_penalty
components.description: Small penalty for high horizontal speed to encourage staying above pad.

components.name: crash_penalty
components.description: Large penalty if terminated due to crash (game_over) or out-of-bounds.

total_reward_formula: success_bonus + distance_shaping + vertical_speed_shaping + angle_shaping + fuel_penalty + time_penalty + horizontal_velocity_penalty + crash_penalty
